signing_contract: Ed25519 signature, canonical base64, over UTF-8 OYI-IQ11F-OWNER-AUTHORIZATION-V1 followed by newline followed by JSON of claims with sorted keys, no whitespace. Use exported ownerAuthorizationMessage; no private signing key is needed by Oyi.
owner_fields: Owner chooses a unique 8-100 character alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen authorization_id, enrolled key_id and explicit issue/expiry timestamps no more than 30 days apart.
enrollment_requirement: Separately approve and review the owner-controlled Ed25519 public key. Do not generate or enroll an operator key as owner identity. Never supply the owner's private key to Oyi or chat.
